description: This source file defines extension methods for the IGrainContext interface related to IGrainExtension components within the Orleans framework. It provides a method to retrieve a grain extension from the grain context, primarily used in generated code.

classes.name: GrainContextComponentExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to interact with grain context components.

methods.name: GetGrainExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specified grain extension from the grain context, throws an exception if the extension binder is not available.
